title: copilot tools / Enable Copilot tools in Foundry Toolkit
content: ## Enable Copilot tools in Foundry Toolkit Enable the relevant tools so {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} can use Toolkit guidance while working on your project. 1. Open the {% data variables.copilot.chat_view %} `kb(workbench.action.chat.open)`. Select the **Copilot** harness and **Agent** role for the session. 2. Run **Chat: Open Customizations** from the Command Palette, then select **Tools**. For shared tool-management instructions, see [Manage available tools](/docs/agents/run/tools.md#manage-available-tools). 3. Find the Foundry Toolkit tools and enable those relevant to your task. Common guidance tools include: * **Get AI Model Guidance** for model discovery and setup guidance. * **Get Agent Code Generation Best Practices** for agent development guidance. * **Get Evaluation Code Generation Best Practices** for evaluation code guidance. * **Get Tracing Code Generation Best Practices** for instrumentation guidance. Supporting tools provide selected-project context, list deployed models, prepare debugging, and guide evaluation planning. The list is not limited to these four tools. Toolkit also contributes [skills](#understand-foundry-skills), which provide instructions for a broader workflow. You can describe your goal in chat without manually invoking each tool. > [!NOTE] > The model selected in chat powers {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %}. It is separate from the model deployment your generated application calls. Enabling Toolkit tools does not change your application's model or create a deployment. For chat model selection, see [Language models in chat](/docs/agent-customization/language-models.md).
